# plugin

The `plugin` command groups subcommands for interacting with Vault's plugins and
the plugin catalog

## Examples

List all available secret plugins in the catalog:

```shell-session
$ vault plugin list secret

Name            Version
----            -------
ad              v0.14.0+builtin
alicloud        v0.13.0+builtin
...
```

Register an official Enterprise plugin from its extracted release artifact:

```shell-session
$ vault plugin register \
  -version="v0.16.0+ent" \
  secret vault-plugin-secrets-keymgmt
Success! Registered plugin: vault-plugin-secrets-keymgmt
```

For official Enterprise plugins, use the versioned `.zip` release artifact and
do not provide `-sha256`. Refer to the
[plugin registration guide](/vault/docs/plugins/register) for download and
extraction steps.

Register a community or custom plugin from a binary:

```shell-session
$ PLUGIN_SHA=$(sha256sum ./my-custom-plugin | awk '{print $1}')
$ vault plugin register \
  -command="my-custom-plugin" \
  -sha256="${PLUGIN_SHA}" \
  auth my-custom-plugin
Success! Registered plugin: my-custom-plugin
```

You can also use `-download` <EnterpriseAlert inline="true"/> **(BETA)** to
download an official plugin from the
[HashiCorp releases page](https://releases.hashicorp.com/):

```shell-session
$ vault plugin register \
  -download \
  -version="v0.16.0+ent" \
  secret vault-plugin-secrets-keymgmt
```

Get information about a plugin in the catalog:

```shell-session
$ vault plugin info secret my-custom-plugin
Key                   Value
---                   -----
args                  []
builtin               false
command               my-custom-plugin
deprecation_status    n/a
name                  my-custom-plugin
oci_image             n/a
runtime               n/a
sha256                33e72f3d30ff2acdbf3cf3c8fa1c8945b60dab876c4226ab25617a63c9f16cc5
version               n/a
```

## Usage

```text
Usage: vault plugin <subcommand> [options] [args]

  # ...

Subcommands:
    deregister       Deregister an existing plugin in the catalog
    info             Read information about a plugin in the catalog
    list             Lists available plugins
    register         Registers a new plugin in the catalog
    reload           Reload mounted plugin backend
    reload-status    Get the status of an active or recently completed global plugin reload
```

For more information, examples, and usage about a subcommand, click on the name
of the subcommand in the sidebar.
